# Changes to BC OnLine Search and Corporate Online application replacement coming soon

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (11/23/2022):

In spring 2023, the BC OnLine and the Corporate Online application will no longer be used to access Corporate Search and filings for BC Companies. Read more [here](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/employment-business-and-economic-development/business-management/permits-licences-and-registration/registries-other-assets/corps_notice_nov_2022.pdf).

Additional information regarding the APIs for BC corporations will follow soon.

---

**maribeth.wilson** (6/6/2023):

Subject: Corporate Online and Corporate Search Update

In November of 2022, BC Registries and Online Services communicated that Corporate Online and Corporate Search would be upgraded and replaced with services in the new BC Registry application.

The original timeline for the migration of Corporations to the new[ BC Registry application](https://www.bcregistry.gov.bc.ca/) was widely publicized as Spring 2023. This timeline has been reviewed and it has been determined that more time is needed for users and internal parties to prepare. A new go-live date will be established in the coming months.

More information will follow.
